results.title: Revolut Group Holdings Ltd 2025 Annual Report with Sustainability Disclosures - Free PDF
highlights:
## Report overview

The report presents a record 2025 for Revolut, with consolidated revenue of £4,515,770 thousand and profit before tax of £1,713,273 thousand. The retail customer base reached 68.3 million, while the Group operated as a licensed bank in 30 countries. The report also discloses 12,200 year-end employees and a Board-approved realignment of its net-zero target to 2050. Its ESG section includes SECR energy and emissions disclosures and extensive climate-risk governance.

highlights:
## Driving the Dream Team

From opening new offices to growing our grad programme, we continued to find new ways to help our remote-first teams get it done, making us a certified great place to work in 14 countries.

A great place to work

We’re certified as a great place to work in the UK, India, Poland, Lithuania, Romania, Hungary, Spain, Portugal, and 6 other countries.

New global offices

We opened our global HQ in London and Western Europe HQ in Paris. New offices in Madrid and Barcelona are next.

1.7M job applications

Intern and grad programmes doubled in size, and in 2025 we attracted more top talent than ever.

results.title: Revolut has seen a sharp increase in revenue: key figures for 2025 - Komersant Ukrainian
results.author: Anna Tkachenko Editor
highlights:
## Operations

The company’s workforce grew from 10,000 to 12,200 employees last year. Total personnel expenses rose to £922 million, while administrative expenses amounted to £1.8 billion. £528.8 million was allocated to marketing and advertising.

The loan portfolio grew to £2.2 billion, including mortgage loans for the first time, from approximately £1 billion.

In 2025, the company conducted a share buyback from employees based on a market valuation of the business at $75 billion. Over 2,100 employees from 32 countries participated in this process.

## About Revolut

Revolut is a financial technology company that offers banking, peer-to-peer payments, and investing to consumers through its mobile app. The company started with low-cost currency exchange and international transfers, but has expanded into savings, debit cards, stock and crypto trading, business accounts, and lending.
